lines: Velimir's voice lines and sound effects.
- "Ooh, ah, no disrespect, but you're gonna need security clearance. Apologies."
- "Well hello. Velimir Volkov II. And this is Minerva Hendricks, my, uh, partner. Business partner."
Velimir: "Gonna have to cut prices again. People just don't wanna buy furniture in a lockdown."
- Minerva: "Great, all the more custom for my side of the trade."
Minerva: "Tactical solutions are available to discreet buyers."
Velimir: "Remember how romantic this city was the first time we came?"
- Minerva: "Yeah, I had to close up your stomach wound with a staple gun."
Minerva: "We need to get after her, Velimir. She's still our responsibility."
- Velimir: "So we keep on working with Kaya until something turns up!"
Velimir: "Well I coulda fixed this place up better than Captain Teabag!"
- Minerva: "You're insulting our hosts, and you're embarrassing me."
- Velimir: "You need luxury goods? Fine furnishings? I'll fix you right up!"
- "So what can Höllvania's finest foster parents do for you today?"
- "Okay, okay, what can we get for you? Sideboards or shotguns? Recliners or rifles? Bazookas or... Bazookas... you get it."
- "You know, I'm not really a bartender."

- "So, funny story. Our cover identity was meant to be 'corporate sales reps'. So Minerva and I rock up in Höllvania with a ton of merchandise, pockets full of bribe money, replica Scaldra weapons in a hidden compartment in case a coup needs to go down, ya know, usual stuff. Then we got Infested, met Entrati, yada yada, corporate story goes out the window. So now I'm eating cold ravioli out of cans and sitting on a shipping container full of honestly kinda random stock. Ya know, I could cut you a deal if you're interested."
- "What do you do when they move out and take their stuff? Ya buy more stuff."
- "In every dream home... you know how it goes."
- "Sure you could furnish an apartment with this, but you could also build a maze."
- "If you ever need to build a barricade out of arcade cabinets, well I'm your guy."
- "Hey, need a couch? Cozy, but big enough to snuggle on? Know what I mean? Say no more."
- "Entrati left you a brick cell, bud. Now you owe it to yourself to make it your own."
- "No more Drifting. Time you settled down tiger."
Minerva: "Velimir. Enough with the cutesy little ice crystals."
- Velimir: "Don't know what you mean. Drifter's not complaining."
Velimir: "You really think Neci will want to see you again?"
- Minerva: "Gods forbid we don't give ever everything she wants."
Minerva: "Are you going to keep picking at those bar snacks?"
- Velimir: "(muffled crunching) I dunno. You gonna keep riding my ass about it?"
Velimir: "Heh. When she finally gets up, that bar stool's gonna have a truly epic butt print. Shh."
- Minerva: "Ignore him, Drifter. It's an easy feat to learn, trust me."
Minerva: "Being stuck here with you reminds me of my RTI training."
- Velimir: "That so? Reminds me of the time I got locked in a chemical toilet and rolled downhill."
Velimir: "Well you see, Drifter. It was her voice that first captivated me. Like a rusty nailgun marinated in cooking sherry."
- Minerva: "Ah, Velimir. The soul of a poet trapped in the body of a frathouse couch."
Minerva: "You need to think about what we're going to offer Neci if you ever want to get her back."
- Velimir: "She had the respect of every single Scaldra goon in this city! What do you suppose made her want that so bad?"
Velimir: "Whatever happened to you and me, Minerva?"
- Minerva: "You know damn well what happened."
Minerva: "Believe it or not, Velimir was quite the operative, once. Until his priorities shifted."
- Velimir: "You're goddamn right. Becoming a parent is meant to do that."
Velimir: "Look, Minerva, you hate me, I get it. So leave. Nobody's forcing you to stay here."
- Minerva: "Not a hope. We made this mess together. We'll fix it together."
Minerva: "He used to love buying me chocolates. Funny how he doesn't do that any more."
- Velimir: "Found out it was poisonous to dogs."
Velimir: "Hey, hey, go easy on the Old Fashioneds, Minerva. You know Kaya could call on us any time."
- Minerva: "Yeah, wouldn't want to let her down too, now would we?"
Minerva: "Would you frost my glass a little, good sir?"
- Velimir: "One frosted ass, coming right up."
Velimir: "How did a bum like me end up hitched to a queen?"
- Minerva: "Staying power, honey. That big old glacier just ground me down."
Minerva: "Mmm. My feet are aching after that last run."
- Velimir: "You, uh, want me to take care of that? I can close up for a few."
Velimir: "Do you see what a beauty I get to look at all day, Drifter?"
- Minerva: "Oh, he plays the romantic. But we both know what base and wicked thoughts are circling in that fishbowl of a brain."
Minerva: "He's devoted to me, Drifter. Like a loyal pet."
- Velimir: "What can I say? I crave my belly rubs."
Velimir: "I know they're our friends, but if any of those Hex try putting the moves on you, there's gonna be trouble."
- Minerva: "So crass and yet so charming. My very own thawed-out caveman."
Minerva: "Don't keep us busy too long, Drifter. We do have other business to attend to."
- Velimir: "Aww. She's acting coy. Isn't she cute when she does that?"
Velimir: "You want some ice on those bruises?"
- Minerva: "What a contrived way to ask me to undress."
Minerva: "Ya know, Quincy's been doing good work with the local kids. A lot of them have been left without parents. If Neci never comes back..."
- Velimir: "Let's make that decision when the time comes."
Velimir: "I never meant to be a soft touch. I just loved seeing our kid's eyes light up when I said 'yes'."
- Minerva: "Oh honey, kindness isn't a weakness, Velimir."
- "It ain't clutter if you love it."
- "You are living like royalty, my friend."
- "Now what if Amir wants to come for game night and there aren't enough chairs, huh? Imagine the look on that little guy's face!"
- "Fine, okay, but the time is gonna come when you'll wish you'd bought that traffic cone from me."
- "Need to measure the space first? No problem."
- "Take all the time you need, it's your space."
- "You just wanna browse, you go ahead and browse. Have fun."
- "Maybe Minerva has something more your speed."
- "May the wind be ever at your back!"
For full dialogue including responses, see Temporal Archimedea/Quotes.
- "At least I can understand what those boys are singing."
- "Is this what the kids are calling a mosh pit? I can see the appeal."
- "Right. Well... That's part of the reason we're here, isn't it? No time to get sentimental."
- "Over already? I was just getting into it."
- "Guess Minerva was right. Neci was getting in with a bad crowd."
- "Killing Scaldra for science! Because we're the good guys. Go team."
- "If it comes to that, you better let me know, Kaya. "
- "How about you sweat the details and I'll stick to dismantling Techrot."
- "Now, isn't this stuff supposed to have a hivemind somewhere? You really want to risk pissing it off?"
- "So you want all this Techrot junked?"
- "Great! I'm happy for us. Sincerely. So who's next?"
- "I seem to remember when these Hell-Scrubbers were "going to stop the rot in its tracks," we were so naive back then."
- "Where'd you learn all this mumbo-jumbo anyway?"
- "Okay, Kaya, we're going to get these Hell-Scrubbers up and running. You do- Um... Whatever it is you're doing. "
- "Yeah, this is a world worth saving. Screaming fungus and demon appliances. Gotta make sure all this survives."
- "Kaya... I gotta ask, how is this 'science'? I'm scrubbing the freakin' streets over here!"
- "I think we sucked up some of the old O.R.O. research data. Damn, those people were into some shady shit. Move on. Let's wrap this up."
- "Couldn't you go down to the stream and poke frogspawn like a normal kid?"
- "So I get to round 'em up and sift through their brains. Eh, I guess it's honest work."
- "Okay, another one in the bag. Hey Kaya - are we learning anything from this?"
- "I swear these things are getting smarter."
- "Okay, now that last one was an ugly son-of-a-b. "
- "You want us to take out one of Vodyanoi's fancy new tanks? Yeah, I think we can oblige."
- "An Efervon tank? Oh, I thought she'd never ask."
- "Yeah. Turns out that tank was a real can-of-worms."
- "Oh, so this is my fault too? "
- "Viktor is now short one armored nightmare."
- "So, Minerva, you up for seeing a little live music?"
- "Remember when I used to take you out dancing? Wasn't so long ago."
- "The show will go on. We'll make sure of it."
- "PLAY FREE DOVE!!!! Wait... why we stopping??"
- "I was never much for math, but I trust that you are."
- "Hey, Scaldra. You could have just gone home and left Höllvania in peace, but you had to show here, didn't ya?"
- "Hey Minerva, remember when I'd get you all worked up?"
- "Then we go down trying. But we do it together."
- "Things are getting pretty heavy down here, Kaya."
- "Very funny, Kaya. Never heard that joke before. Frickin' kids these days."
- "Minerva. You know whatever we do here, it's not going to bring Neci back, right?"
- "Gods damn. This is a workout. Should have stretched."
- "In theory? Well, I've risked more on worse intel. Let's go."
- "Ya know I kinda like this kitty. Hey, what do you say about getting a cat for the bar?"
- "Whoa. Kaya. You didn't make this mess and if all you do is keep it from getting just a little bit worse, well that's a win in my books."
- "How about Vel mixes you up an Old Fashioned. I know just how you like 'em."
- "You got a cold front moving in. Hi."
- "Sit back. Let Papa take care of it."
- "Ah, breaking out the big guns, huh?"
- "Whose mess we gotta clean up this time?"
- "I don't care who started it. I'm finishing it."
- "Oh yeah. It's Velimir. In the flesh."
- "No, no, don't go easy on me. I'm built for the rough jobs."
- "Ugh. Yeah. They don't make 'em like me anymore."
- "Oh, feels like I lost a few pounds."
- "Now where in the hell were you hiding?"
- "You okay if I clock out for a few?"
- "Well, damn. Feels kinda empty in here without you."
- "You come, you go. You know, you treat this body like a freaking hotel."
- "Ah, appreciate it. A guy needs his brain all to himself sometimes."
- "Oh, you heading out? Okay. Have fun out there."
- "Well, I should have brought a book."
- "There you go. Just shrug me off like a big old overcoat."
- "And out of the cocoon came a beautiful butterfly."
- "Now that is some spooky shit you could do there, gotta tell ya."
- "You get in over your head, come get me. Okay?"
- "Ha! Look at you, all dressed and ready to go!"
- "I think you stepped on my liver on the way out. Thanks."
- "I will be right here. Okie dokie?"
- "Just gonna leave me here, huh? Okay. Your decision."
- "Don't be long, okay? Hey, you know I worry."
- "You just snuggle down nice and cozy."
- "Snug as a bug in a rug."
- "Buckle up because that's a prime specimen of Libertatian manhood you're driving."
- "Okay, back to giving piggyback rides to a ghost."
- "It gives me goosebumps all over when you do that."
- "Hey, how about we stop and get a burger, what do you say?"
- "Get comfy, kid. There's work to do."
- "You are now in control of some top-quality Libertatian Army surplus."
- "Come on, give the biceps a flex."
- "Hope you like the taste of cigar smoke, kid."
- "Hey, we got volunteers for fertilizer detail."
- "You are dangerously close to pissing me off!"
- "This bunch has got to be fresh out of bad guy boot camp. Wow."
- "Yeah, try and jump us. See how that works out for you."
- "Anyone want to say a few words for a random jerkoff?"
- "Oh, now that didn't go the way you were hoping, did it?"
- "Yeah, that was as much fun as it looked."
- "Yeah, gonna take a pressure washer to clean that up."
- "You just gotta know where to hit them."
- "Well, I kick them, but these are my good boots."
- "Oh yeah, love pulling out that move."
- "And that is why you gotta practice your takedowns."
- "Haha, gotta tell Minerva about that kill."
- "Metal, bone, it all shatters if you hit it right."
- "Oh crap. Gonna need a hand up here."
- "If someone could get to me before I black out, that'd be swell."
- "Get me back on my feet, or you'll be stuck with one hell of a throw rug!"
- "Whoa. Legs kinda gave way under me."
- "Oh, that's a lot of blood. It's mine? Oh, how about that."
- "Would it kill you to help an old man get back to his feet?"
- "I need some help over here. What, are you gonna make me beg?"
- "I hate to admit it, but... I need a medic."
- "Oh damn. I ain't shrugging this one off. Medic!"
- "No, no, no! This is not gonna be my sad soundtrack moment!"
- "Just gonna leave me to bleed out, huh?"
- "Whatever I said, I take it back. Now please, a little help?"
- "Uh, squad? You know what to do in a medical emergency, right?"
- "I could use some medical assistance right about now. Please?"
- "Ooh, that last one went deep. Ugh."
- "So be honest, when they took me down, did it look cool?"
- "Hey, hey, no hugs. Well, maybe a quick one. Come here."
- "Not ready for the glue factory yet!"
- "You wanna tell my driver to be more careful next time?"
- "I'm in the mood for a little payback."
- "You press this thing and it marks the map, see? Technology."
- "How about I just show you where to go?"
- "Ooh, let's all pick on this one."
- "Just gonna slap a target on this one here."
- "Don't care how you take them down. Just get it done."
- "First one to take them out gets a cookie."
- "Eh, shoot him, stab him... I don't care."
- "Huh, you sure it'll take my weight?"
- "I've gotta get me one of those, yeah."
